ios.desc:
Create Your Sound
Craft unique musical experiences by mixing up to four premium beats across different tempos. TypeBeat's intuitive interface lets you build professional-quality tracks in seconds.
Simple Controls
The elegant top row provides essential tools: output selection, playback control, pitch lock, and wake lock—all designed with precision.
Perfect Synchronization
Select any tempo to instantly resync all tracks from their starting points, ensuring flawless timing with every beat.
Intuitive Mixing
Add beats with a simple tap, then fine-tune individual volumes for the perfect balance. The color-coded system helps you identify complementary keys for harmonic perfection.
Effortless Management
Remove tracks with a smooth swipe gesture, maintaining your creative flow without interruption.
Let one or two beats lead while others provide subtle texture—discover your signature sound with TypeBeat.
